# @plurid/uitive-core

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs` from packages/core/src: edit the JSDoc there. -->

The contract, the client, data and policy: everything that adapts an interface, in any JavaScript runtime, with no DOM or Node APIs.

Install: `pnpm add @plurid/uitive-core`, with `zod` ^4.2.0 as a peer. Guides: [Getting started](../getting-started.md), [Contracts](../contracts.md), [Data and actions](../data-and-actions.md), [Pages](../pages.md).

## Contracts

Source: [`contract.ts`](../../packages/core/src/contract.ts), [`ids.ts`](../../packages/core/src/ids.ts), [`json.ts`](../../packages/core/src/json.ts)

### action

Declares something people can do, such as `orders.cancel`. Without an `effect` it belongs to
the interface only; with one it runs through the bindings' `perform`, and writes wait for the
person's yes.

```ts
function action<const P extends z.ZodObject = z.ZodObject<{}>>(spec: ActionSpec<P>): ActionSpec<P>;
```

Uses: [`ActionSpec`](#actionspec).

### assertIds

Throws unless every ID matches its pattern and none collide ignoring case.

```ts
function assertIds(domain: string, ids: readonly string[], pattern?: RegExp): void;
```

### block

Declares a part pages are built from: one of the application's own components, with typed props.

```ts
function block<P>(spec: BlockSpec<P>): BlockSpec<P>;
```

Uses: [`BlockSpec`](#blockspec).

### canonicaliser

Maps a value to the canonical ID it names, comparing case-insensitively.

```ts
function canonicaliser(ids: readonly string[]): (value: string) => string | undefined;
```

### choice

Declares one value out of a fixed set, such as a theme or a density.

```ts
function choice<const V extends string>(
  spec: Omit<ChoiceSpec<V>, 'kind' | 'default'> & {
    default: NoInfer<V>;
  },
): ChoiceSpec<V>;
```

Uses: [`ChoiceSpec`](#choicespec).

### collection

Declares generated items, such as saved views or macros, that people accept, edit or dismiss.

```ts
function collection<T>(spec: Omit<CollectionSpec<T>, 'kind'>): CollectionSpec<T>;
```

Uses: [`CollectionSpec`](#collectionspec).

### CONTRACT_FORMAT

What a JSON contract says it is, in its `format` field.

```ts
const CONTRACT_FORMAT = 'uitive.contract';
```

### defineApp

Declares what may adapt in an application. Validates every ID and reference, and freezes
the result: the contract is the boundary planners work within.

```ts
function defineApp<
  const A extends Record<string, ActionSpec>,
  const S extends Record<string, SurfaceSpec<Extract<keyof A, string>>>,
  const C extends Record<string, readonly string[]> = Record<never, never>,
  const D extends Record<string, AnySourceSpec> = Record<never, never>,
>(spec: ContractSpec<A, S, C, D>): Contract<A, S, C, D>;
```

Uses: [`ActionSpec`](#actionspec), [`AnySourceSpec`](#anysourcespec), [`Contract`](#contract), [`ContractSpec`](#contractspec), [`SurfaceSpec`](#surfacespec).

### fieldsFromJson

Fields back from JSON, as the zod object describeFields reads them from.

```ts
function fieldsFromJson(json: FieldsJson): z.ZodObject;
```

Uses: [`FieldsJson`](#fieldsjson).

### fieldsToJson

Fields as canonical JSON: every meaning written out, so nothing is inferred on the way back.

```ts
function fieldsToJson(fields: readonly Field[]): FieldsJson;
```

Uses: [`Field`](#field-type), [`FieldsJson`](#fieldsjson).

### FORMAT_VERSION

The JSON contract format's version.

```ts
const FORMAT_VERSION = 2;
```

### fromJson

Loads a contract from JSON. It is checked as `defineApp` checks any contract; validators can
be reattached through `runtime`, since JSON can't carry them.

```ts
function fromJson(raw: unknown, runtime?: Runtime): Contract;
```

Uses: [`Contract`](#contract), [`Runtime`](#runtime).

### ID_PATTERN

Action IDs, context values and choice values: everything a planner may emit as an enum
value. Lowercase only, because structured outputs don't guarantee the casing of enum values.

```ts
const ID_PATTERN: RegExp = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.:-]*$/;
```

### itemSchema

The JSON Schema of a collection item, or a marker when zod can't represent it.

```ts
function itemSchema(schema: z.ZodType): unknown;
```

### list

Declares an ordered selection of actions, such as a toolbar or a menu: the first `capacity` show
and the rest wait in overflow.

```ts
function list<const A extends string>(
  spec: Omit<ListSpec<A>, 'kind' | 'required' | 'available'> & {
    required?: readonly NoInfer<A>[];
    available?(value: string): readonly NoInfer<A>[];
  },
): ListSpec<A>;
```

Uses: [`ListSpec`](#listspec).

### page

A page made of these blocks: `page({ table, chart })({ label, description, standard })`.
Taking the blocks first fixes their types, so the standard page is checked against them.

```ts
function page<const B extends Record<string, BlockSpec>>(
  blocks: B,
): (spec: Omit<PageSpec<B>, 'kind' | 'blocks'>) => PageSpec<B>;
```

Uses: [`BlockSpec`](#blockspec), [`PageSpec`](#pagespec).

### SURFACE_PATTERN

Surface names are identifiers in application code.

```ts
const SURFACE_PATTERN: RegExp = /^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$/;
```

### toJson

A contract as data. Functions become data (a list's items per context value, standard pages)
or are left out (validators). Schemas that would not survive the trip back are refused, so
`fromJson(toJson(c)).hash === c.hash`.

```ts
function toJson(contract: AnyContract): ContractJson;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`ContractJson`](#contractjson).

### ActionIdOf

A contract's action IDs, as a union, such as `ActionIdOf<typeof shop>`.

```ts
type ActionIdOf<T extends AnyContract> = Extract<keyof T['actions'], string>;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract).

### ActionJson

One action as JSON: its label, description, params as JSON Schema, and effect.

Uses: [`Effect`](#effect), [`FieldsJson`](#fieldsjson), [`Filter`](#filter).

| Property       | Type         | Description                                         |
| -------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`        | `string`     | Shown to people and to the model.                   |
| `description`  | `string`     | What the action does.                               |
| `group?`       | `string`     | The action's group.                                 |
| `aliases?`     | `string[]`   | Former IDs, so stored usage survives a rename.      |
| `params?`      | `FieldsJson` | What a run takes.                                   |
| `effect?`      | `Effect`     | What a run does to data.                            |
| `confirm?`     | `string`     | For destructive actions: the phrase a run asks for. |
| `when?`        | `Filter[]`   | For row actions: the rows it applies to.            |
| `invalidates?` | `string[]`   | Sources a run changes.                              |

### ActionSpec

Something a user can do.

Uses: [`Effect`](#effect), [`Filter`](#filter).

Type parameters: `P extends z.ZodObject = z.ZodObject`.

| Property       | Type                | Default   | Description                                                                              |
| -------------- | ------------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`        | `string`            |           | Shown to people and to the model.                                                        |
| `description`  | `string`            |           | What the action does, written for people and models alike.                               |
| `group?`       | `string`            |           | Groups related actions, for display and for the model.                                   |
| `aliases?`     | `readonly string[]` | `[]`      | Former IDs of this action, so stored usage survives a rename.                            |
| `params?`      | `P`                 |           | What a run takes: flat fields, like a source's row. A `ref` param makes it a row action. |
| `effect?`      | `Effect`            |           | What a run does. Without one, the action belongs to the interface only.                  |
| `confirm?`     | `string`            | the label | For destructive actions: what the user types to confirm.                                 |
| `when?`        | `readonly Filter[]` | every row | For row actions: the rows it applies to, as filters on the row's source.                 |
| `invalidates?` | `readonly string[]` | `[]`      | Sources a run changes, so results that read them refresh.                                |

### ActionView

An action as a surface shows it.

Type parameters: `A extends string = string`.

| Property      | Type      | Description                                                      |
| ------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`          | `A`       | The action's ID.                                                 |
| `label`       | `string`  | The action's label.                                              |
| `description` | `string`  | What the action does.                                            |
| `group?`      | `string`  | The action's group, when it has one.                             |
| `pinned`      | `boolean` | The user pinned it here.                                         |
| `moved`       | `boolean` | It moved here through an applied operation, for "moved" markers. |

### AnyContract

Any contract, with its IDs widened to strings: what generic code works with.

Uses: [`ActionSpec`](#actionspec), [`AnySourceSpec`](#anysourcespec), [`Field`](#field-type), [`FieldPath`](#fieldpath), [`RegionSpec`](#regionspec), [`ResolvedSource`](#resolvedsource), [`RouteSpec`](#routespec), [`SurfaceSpec`](#surfacespec).

| Property         | Type                                                       | Description                                                                            |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`             | `string`                                                   | The application's ID.                                                                  |
| `version`        | `string`                                                   | The version the application gave, for changes the hash can't see.                      |
| `description`    | `string`                                                   | What the application is, for the model.                                                |
| `actions`        | `Readonly<Record<string, ActionSpec>>`                     | Every action, by ID.                                                                   |
| `contexts`       | `Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>`              | Every context, with its values.                                                        |
| `sources`        | `Readonly<Record<string, AnySourceSpec>>`                  | Every source, by ID.                                                                   |
| `regions`        | `Readonly<Record<string, RegionSpec>>`                     | Every region, by name.                                                                 |
| `routes`         | `Readonly<Record<string, RouteSpec>>`                      | Every route, by ID.                                                                    |
| `surfaces`       | `Readonly<Record<string, SurfaceSpec>>`                    | Every surface, by name.                                                                |
| `hash`           | `string`                                                   | Changes whenever anything a planner sees changes.                                      |
| `actionIds`      | `readonly string[]`                                        | Every action ID, in declaration order.                                                 |
| `sourceIds`      | `readonly string[]`                                        | Every source ID, in declaration order.                                                 |
| `routeIds`       | `readonly string[]`                                        | Every route ID, in declaration order.                                                  |
| `surfaceIds`     | `readonly string[]`                                        | Every surface name, in declaration order.                                              |
| `action()`       | `(id: string) => string \| undefined`                      | The action an ID or former ID names, compared case-insensitively.                      |
| `surface()`      | `(name: string) => string \| undefined`                    | The surface a name refers to, compared case-insensitively.                             |
| `contextValue()` | `(context: string, value: string) => string \| undefined`  | The canonical value of a context, compared case-insensitively.                         |
| `items()`        | `(surface: string, context?: string) => readonly string[]` | The items a list offers, for one context value when the list is keyed by context.      |
| `source()`       | `(id: string) => ResolvedSource \| undefined`              | A source with its fields described, by ID compared case-insensitively.                 |
| `path()`         | `(name: string) => FieldPath \| undefined`                 | A qualified field name such as `payments.customer.email`, compared case-insensitively. |
| `params()`       | `(action: string) => readonly Field[]`                     | An action's params, described as fields. Empty when it takes none.                     |
| `route()`        | `(name: string) => string \| undefined`                    | The route a name refers to, compared case-insensitively.                               |

### AnyPageSpec

Any page surface, with its blocks widened.

Uses: [`AnyPage`](#anypage), [`BlockSpec`](#blockspec), [`GenericName`](#genericname), [`SectionsPage`](#sectionspage).

| Property       | Type                                                        | Default                         | Description                                                                                    |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`         | `'page'`                                                    |                                 | Says the surface is a page.                                                                    |
| `blocks`       | `Readonly<Record<string, BlockSpec>>`                       |                                 | The application's own blocks the page may use, besides sections, tabs and regions.             |
| `context?`     | `string`                                                    |                                 | The context that keys this page, such as `service`; it can be redesigned per value or for all. |
| `entity?`      | `string`                                                    |                                 | The source whose rows this page is about, such as `customers`; `$current` names the row.       |
| `generic?`     | `boolean \| readonly GenericName[]`                         | every one the contract can feed | Generic blocks the page offers.                                                                |
| `standard()`   | `(context: string \| undefined) => AnyPage \| SectionsPage` |                                 | The page before anyone changes it, for a context value when the page has a context.            |
| `maxElements?` | `number`                                                    | `40`                            | How many elements a page may hold.                                                             |
| `maxDepth?`    | `number`                                                    | `4`                             | How deeply a page's sections may nest.                                                         |
| `maxQueries?`  | `number`                                                    | `8`                             | Queries a page may run.                                                                        |
| `label`        | `string`                                                    |                                 | Shown to people, such as "Toolbar".                                                            |
| `description`  | `string`                                                    |                                 | What the surface is for, written for people and models alike.                                  |

### BlockOf

One placed block: which block, with which props.

```ts
type BlockOf<B extends Record<string, BlockSpec>> = {
  [K in Extract<keyof B, string>]: {
    block: K;
    props: PropsOf<B[K]>;
  };
}[Extract<keyof B, string>];
```

Uses: [`BlockSpec`](#blockspec), [`PropsOf`](#propsof).

### BlockSpec

A part pages are built from: a component the application renders, with typed props.

Type parameters: `P = unknown`.

| Property      | Type                                                              | Description                                                                                         |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`       | `string`                                                          | Shown to people, such as "Resource table".                                                          |
| `description` | `string`                                                          | What the block shows and how its props change it, for people and models alike.                      |
| `props`       | `z.ZodType<P>`                                                    | The schema of the block's props. Planners can only produce props it accepts.                        |
| `validate?()` | `(props: P, context: string \| undefined) => string \| undefined` | Application rules beyond the schema, given the page's context value; returns why props are invalid. |

### ChoiceSpec

One value out of a fixed set.

Type parameters: `V extends string = string`.

| Property      | Type           | Description                                                   |
| ------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`        | `'choice'`     | Says the surface is a choice.                                 |
| `values`      | `readonly V[]` | Every value, in the order people see them.                    |
| `default`     | `V`            | The value before anyone chooses one.                          |
| `label`       | `string`       | Shown to people, such as "Toolbar".                           |
| `description` | `string`       | What the surface is for, written for people and models alike. |

### CollectionEntry

One item of a collection, with the operation that added it.

Type parameters: `T = unknown`.

| Property    | Type     | Description                                                     |
| ----------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`        | `string` | The item's ID.                                                  |
| `title`     | `string` | Its title, from the collection's `title`.                       |
| `value`     | `T`      | The item itself.                                                |
| `operation` | `string` | The operation that added it, for Revert, Keep and explanations. |

### CollectionSpec

Generated items, such as macros or saved views, that users accept, edit or dismiss.

Type parameters: `T = unknown`.

| Property      | Type                               | Description                                                          |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`        | `'collection'`                     | Says the surface is a collection.                                    |
| `item`        | `z.ZodType<T>`                     | The schema of one item. Planners can only produce items it accepts.  |
| `max`         | `number`                           | At most this many accepted items.                                    |
| `title()`     | `(item: T) => string`              | A short title for an item, shown to people.                          |
| `validate?()` | `(item: T) => string \| undefined` | Application rules beyond the schema; returns why an item is invalid. |
| `label`       | `string`                           | Shown to people, such as "Toolbar".                                  |
| `description` | `string`                           | What the surface is for, written for people and models alike.        |

### CollectionValue

A collection as a person's interface has it: the items they accepted, and suggestions waiting for
an answer.

Uses: [`CollectionEntry`](#collectionentry).

Type parameters: `T = unknown`.

| Property      | Type                            | Description                                                    |
| ------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items`       | `readonly CollectionEntry<T>[]` | Items the person accepted or added.                            |
| `suggestions` | `readonly CollectionEntry<T>[]` | Proposed items waiting for the user to accept or dismiss them. |

### ContextOf

A contract's context names, as a union.

```ts
type ContextOf<T extends AnyContract> = Extract<keyof T['contexts'], string>;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract).

### Contract

A contract as `defineApp` returns it: the spec checked and frozen, with its IDs listed and the
hash that identifies it.

Uses: [`ActionSpec`](#actionspec), [`AnySourceSpec`](#anysourcespec), [`SurfaceSpec`](#surfacespec).

Type parameters: `A extends Record<string, ActionSpec> = Record<string, ActionSpec>`, `S extends Record<string, SurfaceSpec> = Record<string, SurfaceSpec>`, `C extends Record<string, readonly string[]> = Record<string, readonly string[]>`, `D extends Record<string, AnySourceSpec> = Record<string, AnySourceSpec>`.

| Property         | Type                                                       | Description                                                                            |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `actions`        | `A`                                                        | Every action, by ID.                                                                   |
| `contexts`       | `C`                                                        | Every context, with its values.                                                        |
| `sources`        | `D`                                                        | Every source, by ID.                                                                   |
| `surfaces`       | `S`                                                        | Every surface, by name.                                                                |
| `actionIds`      | `readonly Extract<keyof A, string>[]`                      | Every action ID, in declaration order.                                                 |
| `sourceIds`      | `readonly Extract<keyof D, string>[]`                      | Every source ID, in declaration order.                                                 |
| `surfaceIds`     | `readonly Extract<keyof S, string>[]`                      | Every surface name, in declaration order.                                              |
| `action()`       | `(id: string) => Extract<keyof A, string> \| undefined`    | The action an ID or former ID names, compared case-insensitively.                      |
| `surface()`      | `(name: string) => Extract<keyof S, string> \| undefined`  | The surface a name refers to, compared case-insensitively.                             |
| `id`             | `string`                                                   | The application's ID.                                                                  |
| `version`        | `string`                                                   | The version the application gave, for changes the hash can't see.                      |
| `description`    | `string`                                                   | What the application is, for the model.                                                |
| `regions`        | `Readonly<Record<string, RegionSpec>>`                     | Every region, by name.                                                                 |
| `routes`         | `Readonly<Record<string, RouteSpec>>`                      | Every route, by ID.                                                                    |
| `hash`           | `string`                                                   | Changes whenever anything a planner sees changes.                                      |
| `routeIds`       | `readonly string[]`                                        | Every route ID, in declaration order.                                                  |
| `contextValue()` | `(context: string, value: string) => string \| undefined`  | The canonical value of a context, compared case-insensitively.                         |
| `items()`        | `(surface: string, context?: string) => readonly string[]` | The items a list offers, for one context value when the list is keyed by context.      |
| `source()`       | `(id: string) => ResolvedSource \| undefined`              | A source with its fields described, by ID compared case-insensitively.                 |
| `path()`         | `(name: string) => FieldPath \| undefined`                 | A qualified field name such as `payments.customer.email`, compared case-insensitively. |
| `params()`       | `(action: string) => readonly Field[]`                     | An action's params, described as fields. Empty when it takes none.                     |
| `route()`        | `(name: string) => string \| undefined`                    | The route a name refers to, compared case-insensitively.                               |

### ContractJson

A contract as data: what adapters, agents and hosted planners exchange.

Uses: [`CONTRACT_FORMAT`](#contract_format), [`FORMAT_VERSION`](#format_version), [`ActionJson`](#actionjson), [`RegionSpec`](#regionspec), [`RouteSpec`](#routespec), [`SourceJson`](#sourcejson), [`SurfaceJson`](#surfacejson).

| Property        | Type                          | Description                                                              |
| --------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `format`        | `typeof CONTRACT_FORMAT`      | Says what the document is.                                               |
| `formatVersion` | `typeof FORMAT_VERSION`       | The JSON format's version.                                               |
| `id`            | `string`                      | The application's ID.                                                    |
| `version`       | `string`                      | The version the application gave.                                        |
| `description`   | `string`                      | What the application is, for the model.                                  |
| `actions`       | `Record<string, ActionJson>`  | Every action, by ID.                                                     |
| `contexts`      | `Record<string, string[]>`    | Every context, with its values.                                          |
| `sources`       | `Record<string, SourceJson>`  | Every source, by ID.                                                     |
| `regions`       | `Record<string, RegionSpec>`  | Every region, by name.                                                   |
| `routes`        | `Record<string, RouteSpec>`   | Every route, by ID.                                                      |
| `surfaces`      | `Record<string, SurfaceJson>` | Every surface, by name, with pages' standards written out.               |
| `hash`          | `string`                      | The contract's hash, for checking that two sides mean the same contract. |

### ContractSpec

What `defineApp` takes: the application's actions and surfaces, and optionally its sources,
regions, routes and contexts.

Uses: [`ActionSpec`](#actionspec), [`AnySourceSpec`](#anysourcespec), [`RegionSpec`](#regionspec), [`RouteSpec`](#routespec), [`SurfaceSpec`](#surfacespec).

Type parameters: `A extends Record<string, ActionSpec>`, `S extends Record<string, SurfaceSpec<Extract<keyof A, string>>>`, `C extends Record<string, readonly string[]>`, `D extends Record<string, AnySourceSpec> = Record<never, never>`.

| Property      | Type                                   | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`          | `string`                               |         | Identifies the application, such as `cloud-console`.                                                                                                                                  |
| `version?`    | `string`                               | `'1'`   | Bump when behaviour that can't be hashed changes, such as a validator.                                                                                                                |
| `description` | `string`                               |         | What the application is, written for the model.                                                                                                                                       |
| `actions`     | `A`                                    |         | What people can do. IDs are lowercase, with dots, colons or dashes, such as `orders.cancel` or `table.add-empty`, since structured outputs don't guarantee the casing of enum values. |
| `contexts?`   | `C`                                    | `{}`    | Every value of each context, such as every tool. Names are camelCase; values are lowercase, like action IDs.                                                                          |
| `sources?`    | `D`                                    | `{}`    | Data pages can show, as typed read models.                                                                                                                                            |
| `regions?`    | `Readonly<Record<string, RegionSpec>>` | `{}`    | Parts of the application as it already is, which pages can embed.                                                                                                                     |
| `routes?`     | `Readonly<Record<string, RouteSpec>>`  | `{}`    | Places in the application, for links and for knowing which row a page is about.                                                                                                       |
| `surfaces`    | `S`                                    |         | The parts of the interface people can reshape: lists, choices, collections and pages. Names are identifiers in application code, camelCase, such as `addNew`.                         |

### FieldJson

One field as JSON: its JSON type, and what it means under `x-uitive`.

Uses: [`FieldMeta`](#fieldmeta).

| Property       | Type                                | Description                                                                             |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`         | `'string' \| 'number' \| 'boolean'` | The JSON type the value is stored as.                                                   |
| `enum?`        | `string[]`                          | For enums: every value.                                                                 |
| `description?` | `string`                            | What the field holds.                                                                   |
| `x-uitive`     | `FieldMeta`                         | What the value means to Uitive, beyond its JSON type, such as a money field's currency. |

### FieldsJson

Flat fields as a JSON Schema object: a source's row or an action's params.

Uses: [`FieldJson`](#fieldjson).

| Property     | Type                        | Description                      |
| ------------ | --------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `type`       | `'object'`                  | Always an object.                |
| `properties` | `Record<string, FieldJson>` | Each field, by name.             |
| `required`   | `string[]`                  | The fields every row or run has. |

### ListSpec

An ordered selection of actions: the first `capacity` show, the rest wait in overflow.

Type parameters: `A extends string = string`.

| Property       | Type                              | Default    | Description                                                                            |
| -------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`         | `'list'`                          |            | Says the surface is a list.                                                            |
| `items`        | `readonly A[]`                    |            | Every action the list can show, in standard order.                                     |
| `capacity`     | `number`                          |            | How many items show before the rest move to overflow.                                  |
| `required?`    | `readonly A[]`                    | `[]`       | Items that never move to overflow.                                                     |
| `reorderable?` | `boolean`                         | `false`    | Whether items may leave the standard order.                                            |
| `context?`     | `string`                          |            | The context that keys this list, such as `tool`; each of its values adapts separately. |
| `available?()` | `(value: string) => readonly A[]` | every item | The items available for one context value.                                             |
| `label`        | `string`                          |            | Shown to people, such as "Toolbar".                                                    |
| `description`  | `string`                          |            | What the surface is for, written for people and models alike.                          |

### ListValue

A list as a person's interface has it: the actions that show, then those waiting in overflow.

Uses: [`ActionView`](#actionview).

Type parameters: `A extends string = string`.

| Property   | Type                       | Description                               |
| ---------- | -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `visible`  | `readonly ActionView<A>[]` | The actions that show, in order.          |
| `overflow` | `readonly ActionView<A>[]` | The rest, for a More menu or the palette. |

### PageSection

A section of the first page format, with its blocks typed.

Uses: [`BlockOf`](#blockof), [`BlockSpec`](#blockspec), [`Layout`](#layout).

Type parameters: `B extends Record<string, BlockSpec> = Record<string, BlockSpec>`.

| Property | Type                    | Description                                              |
| -------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`  | `string`                | May be empty.                                            |
| `layout` | `Layout`                | How its blocks are laid out: a stack, a grid or columns. |
| `blocks` | `readonly BlockOf<B>[]` | Its blocks, in order.                                    |

### PageSpec

A page composed from the application's blocks. Users (or a planner, on their behalf) can
redesign it completely, but only out of these parts.

Uses: [`AnyPage`](#anypage), [`BlockSpec`](#blockspec), [`PageValue`](#pagevalue), [`SectionPage`](#sectionpage).

Type parameters: `B extends Record<string, BlockSpec> = Record<string, BlockSpec>`.

| Property       | Type                                                                          | Default                         | Description                                                                                    |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `blocks`       | `B`                                                                           |                                 | The application's own blocks the page may use, besides sections, tabs and regions.             |
| `standard()`   | `(context: string \| undefined) => PageValue<B> \| SectionPage<B> \| AnyPage` |                                 | Typed sections, typed elements, or any page (such as one built with `ui`): all are validated.  |
| `kind`         | `'page'`                                                                      |                                 | Says the surface is a page.                                                                    |
| `context?`     | `string`                                                                      |                                 | The context that keys this page, such as `service`; it can be redesigned per value or for all. |
| `entity?`      | `string`                                                                      |                                 | The source whose rows this page is about, such as `customers`; `$current` names the row.       |
| `generic?`     | `boolean \| readonly GenericName[]`                                           | every one the contract can feed | Generic blocks the page offers.                                                                |
| `maxElements?` | `number`                                                                      | `40`                            | How many elements a page may hold.                                                             |
| `maxDepth?`    | `number`                                                                      | `4`                             | How deeply a page's sections may nest.                                                         |
| `maxQueries?`  | `number`                                                                      | `8`                             | Queries a page may run.                                                                        |
| `label`        | `string`                                                                      |                                 | Shown to people, such as "Toolbar".                                                            |
| `description`  | `string`                                                                      |                                 | What the surface is for, written for people and models alike.                                  |

### PropsOf

The props a block takes.

```ts
type PropsOf<B> = B extends BlockSpec<infer P> ? P : never;
```

Uses: [`BlockSpec`](#blockspec).

### RegionSpec

Part of the application as it already is, which pages can embed, such as the original page.

| Property      | Type     | Description                                                                     |
| ------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`       | `string` | Shown to people and to the model, such as "Payments table".                     |
| `description` | `string` | What it shows, for people and models alike.                                     |
| `entity?`     | `string` | The source whose row it is about, so only pages about that source can embed it. |

### RowOf

One row of a source, as its binding returns it.

```ts
type RowOf<T extends AnyContract, K extends SourceIdOf<T>> = z.infer<T['sources'][K]['row']>;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`SourceIdOf`](#sourceidof).

### Runtime

Functions a JSON contract can't carry, reattached when it is loaded.

```ts
interface Runtime {
  validators?: Readonly<
    Record<string, (value: never, context: string | undefined) => string | undefined>
  >;
}
```

| Property      | Description                                                                   |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `validators?` | Validators by `surface.block` for page blocks, or by surface for collections. |

### SectionPage

A page in the first format, sections of blocks, typed: still accepted for standard pages.

Uses: [`BlockSpec`](#blockspec), [`PageSection`](#pagesection).

Type parameters: `B extends Record<string, BlockSpec> = Record<string, BlockSpec>`.

| Property   | Type                        | Description                    |
| ---------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `sections` | `readonly PageSection<B>[]` | The page's sections, in order. |

### SourceIdOf

A contract's source IDs, as a union.

```ts
type SourceIdOf<T extends AnyContract> = Extract<keyof T['sources'], string>;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract).

### SourceJson

One source as JSON: its fields, key, capabilities and limits.

Uses: [`Capabilities`](#capabilities), [`FieldsJson`](#fieldsjson).

| Property       | Type                     | Description                                          |
| -------------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`        | `string`                 | What people call it.                                 |
| `description`  | `string`                 | What its rows are.                                   |
| `keywords`     | `string[]`               | Other words people use for it.                       |
| `row`          | `FieldsJson`             | The fields of its rows.                              |
| `key`          | `string`                 | The field that identifies a row.                     |
| `title`        | `string`                 | The field that names a row.                          |
| `summary`      | `string[]`               | The fields that sum a row up.                        |
| `capabilities` | `Required<Capabilities>` | What the binding does by itself.                     |
| `scan`         | `number`                 | Most rows fetched to answer one query on the client. |
| `maxLimit`     | `number`                 | Most rows one query may ask for.                     |
| `ttl`          | `number`                 | Seconds a result stays fresh.                        |

### SurfaceIdOf

A contract's surface names, as a union.

```ts
type SurfaceIdOf<T extends AnyContract> = Extract<keyof T['surfaces'], string>;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract).

### SurfaceJson

One surface as JSON, by kind: functions are evaluated, so a page's standard is written out.

```ts
type SurfaceJson =
  | {
      kind: 'list';
      label: string;
      description: string;
      items: string[];
      capacity: number;
      required?: string[];
      reorderable?: boolean;
      context?: string;
      available?: Record<string, string[]>;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'choice';
      label: string;
      description: string;
      values: string[];
      default: string;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'collection';
      label: string;
      description: string;
      item: Record<string, unknown>;
      max: number;
      title: string;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'page';
      label: string;
      description: string;
      context?: string;
      entity?: string;
      generic?: boolean | string[];
      maxElements?: number;
      maxDepth?: number;
      maxQueries?: number;
      blocks: Record<
        string,
        {
          label: string;
          description: string;
          props: Record<string, unknown>;
        }
      >;
      standard: {
        page: AnyPage;
        values?: Record<string, AnyPage>;
      };
    };
```

Uses: [`AnyPage`](#anypage).

### SurfaceSpec

Any surface a contract declares: a list, a choice, a collection or a page.

```ts
type SurfaceSpec<A extends string = string> =
  ListSpec<A> | ChoiceSpec | CollectionSpec | AnyPageSpec;
```

Uses: [`AnyPageSpec`](#anypagespec), [`ChoiceSpec`](#choicespec), [`CollectionSpec`](#collectionspec), [`ListSpec`](#listspec).

### SurfaceValue

What a surface holds, by its kind: a list's visible and overflow actions, a choice's value, a
collection's items or a page.

```ts
type SurfaceValue<Spec> =
  Spec extends ListSpec<infer A>
    ? ListValue<A>
    : Spec extends ChoiceSpec<infer V>
      ? V
      : Spec extends CollectionSpec<infer T>
        ? CollectionValue<T>
        : Spec extends PageSpec<infer B>
          ? PageValue<B>
          : Spec extends AnyPageSpec
            ? AnyPage
            : never;
```

Uses: [`AnyPage`](#anypage), [`AnyPageSpec`](#anypagespec), [`ChoiceSpec`](#choicespec), [`CollectionSpec`](#collectionspec), [`CollectionValue`](#collectionvalue), [`ListSpec`](#listspec), [`ListValue`](#listvalue), [`PageSpec`](#pagespec), [`PageValue`](#pagevalue).

### SurfaceValueOf

What one surface of a contract holds, such as `SurfaceValueOf<typeof shop, 'orders'>`.

```ts
type SurfaceValueOf<T extends AnyContract, K extends SurfaceIdOf<T>> = SurfaceValue<
  T['surfaces'][K]
>;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`SurfaceIdOf`](#surfaceidof), [`SurfaceValue`](#surfacevalue).

## Sources and fields

Source: [`field.ts`](../../packages/core/src/field.ts), [`source.ts`](../../packages/core/src/source.ts)

### ARITY

How many values each operator takes: `[least, most]`.

```ts
const ARITY: Readonly<Record<Op, readonly [number, number]>>;
```

Uses: [`Op`](#op).

### currencyDigits

Decimal places of a currency's minor unit, such as 2 for USD and 0 for JPY.

```ts
function currencyDigits(code: string): number;
```

### describeFields

Describes every field of a row schema. Throws on fields a source can't hold.

```ts
function describeFields(row: z.ZodType, owner?: string): Field[];
```

Uses: [`Field`](#field-type).

### field

Field helpers: zod schemas that also say what a value means, such as money in cents or a
reference to another source. Plain zod types work too, with their meaning inferred.

```ts
const field: {
  text(options?: FieldOptions): z.ZodString;
  number(options?: FieldOptions): z.ZodNumber;
  money(
    options?: FieldOptions & {
      currency?: string;
      code?: string;
      minor?: boolean;
    },
  ): z.ZodNumber;
  time(
    options?: FieldOptions & {
      unit?: 'iso';
    },
  ): z.ZodString;
  time(
    options: FieldOptions & {
      unit: 's' | 'ms';
    },
  ): z.ZodNumber;
  enum<const V extends readonly [string, ...string[]]>(
    values: V,
    options?: FieldOptions,
  ): z.ZodEnum<{
    [K in V[number]]: K;
  }>;
  ref(source: string, options?: FieldOptions): z.ZodString;
  bool(options?: FieldOptions): z.ZodBoolean;
};
```

Uses: [`FieldOptions`](#fieldoptions).

| Member     | Description                                                                             |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `text()`   | Text, such as a name or a description.                                                  |
| `number()` | A number that isn't money, such as a count.                                             |
| `money()`  | `currency` names the field holding each row's currency; `code` fixes one for every row. |
| `time()`   | A moment: an ISO string, or seconds or milliseconds since the epoch with `unit`.        |
| `enum()`   | One of a fixed set of values, such as a status.                                         |
| `ref()`    | The key of a row in another source, which makes the field a relation.                   |
| `bool()`   | Yes or no.                                                                              |

### FIELD_META

Where field metadata lives on a zod schema, and in its JSON Schema.

```ts
const FIELD_META = 'x-uitive';
```

### FIELD_PATTERN

Field names appear in planner enums, so they must survive any casing.

```ts
const FIELD_PATTERN: RegExp = /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/;
```

### FIELD_TYPES

Every type a field may have.

```ts
const FIELD_TYPES: readonly ['text', 'number', 'money', 'time', 'enum', 'ref', 'bool'];
```

### humanise

`amount_refunded` and `amountRefunded` both read "Amount refunded".

```ts
function humanise(name: string): string;
```

### MAX_LIMIT

Rows one query may ask for, unless the source says otherwise.

```ts
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
```

### OPS

Every filter operator; which ones a field takes depends on its type.

```ts
const OPS: readonly [
  'eq',
  'ne',
  'gt',
  'gte',
  'lt',
  'lte',
  'between',
  'in',
  'nin',
  'contains',
  'prefix',
  'empty',
  'present',
];
```

### OPS_BY_TYPE

The operators each field type supports.

```ts
const OPS_BY_TYPE: Readonly<Record<FieldType, readonly Op[]>>;
```

Uses: [`FieldType`](#fieldtype), [`Op`](#op).

### qualifiedFields

Every qualified field name a query on these sources may use.

```ts
function qualifiedFields(
  sources: Readonly<Record<string, ResolvedSource>>,
  ids?: readonly string[],
): string[];
```

Uses: [`ResolvedSource`](#resolvedsource).

### resolvePath

Resolves a qualified field name case-insensitively. A hop reaches only the target source's
summary fields, which keeps the names a planner can emit few.

```ts
function resolvePath(
  sources: Readonly<Record<string, ResolvedSource>>,
  name: string,
): FieldPath | undefined;
```

Uses: [`FieldPath`](#fieldpath), [`ResolvedSource`](#resolvedsource).

### resolveSources

Describes and checks every source; refs must point at sources that exist.

```ts
function resolveSources(
  sources: Readonly<Record<string, AnySourceSpec>>,
): Record<string, ResolvedSource>;
```

Uses: [`AnySourceSpec`](#anysourcespec), [`ResolvedSource`](#resolvedsource).

### SCAN

Rows fetched to answer one query on the client, unless the source says otherwise.

```ts
const SCAN = 500;
```

### source

Declares data pages can show: a typed read model of rows, with the fields that identify and name
them and what the binding does itself. Planners see its schema, never its rows.

```ts
function source<const R extends z.ZodObject>(spec: SourceSpec<R>): SourceSpec<R>;
```

Uses: [`SourceSpec`](#sourcespec).

### SOURCE_PATTERN

Source IDs prefix qualified field names (`payments.amount`), so they hold no dots.

```ts
const SOURCE_PATTERN: RegExp = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/;
```

### TTL

Seconds a result stays fresh, unless the source says otherwise.

```ts
const TTL = 30;
```

### AnySourceSpec

Any source, with its field names widened: what generic code works with.

Uses: [`Capabilities`](#capabilities).

| Property        | Type                | Default      | Description                                                                       |
| --------------- | ------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`         | `string`            |              | Shown to people and to the model, such as "Payments".                             |
| `description`   | `string`            |              | What the rows are, written for people and models alike.                           |
| `keywords?`     | `readonly string[]` | `[]`         | Other words people use for this data, for finding it.                             |
| `row`           | `z.ZodObject`       |              | One row: flat fields only.                                                        |
| `key`           | `string`            |              | The field that identifies a row.                                                  |
| `title?`        | `string`            | the key      | The field that names a row.                                                       |
| `summary?`      | `readonly string[]` | `[title]`    | Fields that sum up a row, shown in compact views and reachable through relations. |
| `capabilities?` | `Capabilities`      | none of them | What the binding does itself: filters, sorts, search and paging.                  |
| `scan?`         | `number`            | `500`        | Most rows fetched to answer one query on the client.                              |
| `maxLimit?`     | `number`            | `100`        | Most rows one query may ask for.                                                  |
| `ttl?`          | `number`            | `30`         | Seconds a result stays fresh.                                                     |

### Capabilities

What a source's binding does itself. Core does everything else on the client.

Uses: [`Op`](#op).

Type parameters: `F extends string = string`.

| Property      | Type                                | Default  | Description                               |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `filter?`     | `Partial<Record<F, readonly Op[]>>` | `{}`     | Filters the binding applies, by field.    |
| `sort?`       | `readonly F[]`                      | `[]`     | Fields the binding sorts by.              |
| `search?`     | `boolean`                           | `false`  | Whether the binding searches text itself. |
| `pagination?` | `'cursor' \| 'offset' \| 'none'`    | `'none'` | How the binding pages through results.    |

### Field type

One field of a source's rows, as everything after the contract sees it.

Uses: [`FieldType`](#fieldtype), [`TimeUnit`](#timeunit).

| Property      | Type                | Description                                                   |
| ------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`        | `string`            | The field's name in its source's rows.                        |
| `type`        | `FieldType`         | What the value means, which decides how it shows and filters. |
| `label`       | `string`            | What people call it.                                          |
| `description` | `string`            | What it holds, for people and models.                         |
| `nullable`    | `boolean`           | Whether rows may lack a value.                                |
| `values`      | `readonly string[]` | For enums: every value.                                       |
| `source?`     | `string`            | For refs: the source whose key the field holds.               |
| `currency?`   | `string`            | For money: the field holding each row's currency.             |
| `code?`       | `string`            | For money: one currency for every row.                        |
| `minor`       | `boolean`           | For money: whether amounts are in minor units.                |
| `unit?`       | `TimeUnit`          | For time: how instants are stored.                            |

### FieldMeta

What a field helper records about a field, beyond its zod type.

Uses: [`FieldType`](#fieldtype), [`TimeUnit`](#timeunit).

| Property    | Type        | Default                     | Description                                                          |
| ----------- | ----------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`      | `FieldType` |                             | What the value means, which decides how it shows and filters.        |
| `label?`    | `string`    | the field's name, humanised | Shown to people.                                                     |
| `currency?` | `string`    |                             | For money: the field holding each row's ISO 4217 currency code.      |
| `code?`     | `string`    |                             | For money: one ISO 4217 currency for every row.                      |
| `minor?`    | `boolean`   | `false`                     | For money: whether amounts are stored in minor units, such as cents. |
| `unit?`     | `TimeUnit`  |                             | For time: how instants are stored.                                   |
| `source?`   | `string`    |                             | For ref: the source whose key this field holds.                      |

### FieldNameOf

A source row's field names, as a union.

```ts
type FieldNameOf<R extends z.ZodObject> = Extract<keyof R['shape'], string>;
```

### FieldOptions

What every field helper takes.

| Property       | Type     | Default                     | Description                                        |
| -------------- | -------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `label?`       | `string` | the field's name, humanised | Shown to people, such as a column's header.        |
| `description?` | `string` |                             | What the field holds, for planners and for people. |

### FieldPath

A field named by a planner: `payments.amount`, or one hop away, `payments.customer.email`.

Uses: [`Field`](#field-type).

| Property  | Type     | Description                                |
| --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `name`    | `string` | The qualified name, in canonical spelling. |
| `source`  | `string` | The source whose rows the query reads.     |
| `via?`    | `string` | The ref field followed, for a hop.         |
| `target?` | `string` | The source a hop reaches.                  |
| `field`   | `Field`  | The field the name reaches.                |

### FieldType

What a field holds, which decides how it is filtered, sorted, summed and shown.

```ts
type FieldType = (typeof FIELD_TYPES)[number];
```

Uses: [`FIELD_TYPES`](#field_types).

### Op

A filter operator. Lowercase, since planners emit them as enum values.

```ts
type Op = (typeof OPS)[number];
```

Uses: [`OPS`](#ops).

### ResolvedSource

A source with its fields described and its defaults filled in.

Uses: [`Capabilities`](#capabilities), [`Field`](#field-type).

| Property       | Type                     | Description                                             |
| -------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`           | `string`                 | The source's ID.                                        |
| `label`        | `string`                 | What people call it.                                    |
| `description`  | `string`                 | What its rows are.                                      |
| `keywords`     | `readonly string[]`      | Other words people use for it.                          |
| `key`          | `string`                 | The field that identifies a row.                        |
| `title`        | `string`                 | The field that names a row.                             |
| `summary`      | `readonly string[]`      | The fields that sum a row up.                           |
| `fields`       | `readonly Field[]`       | Every field, described.                                 |
| `capabilities` | `Required<Capabilities>` | What the binding does by itself, with nothing left out. |
| `scan`         | `number`                 | Most rows fetched to answer one query on the client.    |
| `maxLimit`     | `number`                 | Most rows one query may ask for.                        |
| `ttl`          | `number`                 | Seconds a result stays fresh.                           |

### SourceSpec

Data an application exposes for pages to show: a typed read model, never the rows.

Uses: [`Capabilities`](#capabilities), [`FieldNameOf`](#fieldnameof).

Type parameters: `R extends z.ZodObject = z.ZodObject`.

| Property        | Type                           | Default      | Description                                                                            |
| --------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`         | `string`                       |              | Shown to people and to the model, such as "Payments".                                  |
| `description`   | `string`                       |              | What the rows are, written for people and models alike.                                |
| `keywords?`     | `readonly string[]`            | `[]`         | Other words people use for this data, for finding it.                                  |
| `row`           | `R`                            |              | One row: flat fields only. Field helpers say what values mean, such as money in cents. |
| `key`           | `FieldNameOf<R>`               |              | The field that identifies a row.                                                       |
| `title?`        | `FieldNameOf<R>`               | the key      | The field that names a row.                                                            |
| `summary?`      | `readonly FieldNameOf<R>[]`    | `[title]`    | Fields that sum up a row, shown in compact views and reachable through relations.      |
| `capabilities?` | `Capabilities<FieldNameOf<R>>` | none of them | What the binding does itself: filters, sorts, search and paging.                       |
| `scan?`         | `number`                       | `500`        | Most rows fetched to answer one query on the client.                                   |
| `maxLimit?`     | `number`                       | `100`        | Most rows one query may ask for.                                                       |
| `ttl?`          | `number`                       | `30`         | Seconds a result stays fresh.                                                          |

### TimeUnit

How instants are stored: ISO 8601 strings, or seconds or milliseconds since the epoch.

```ts
type TimeUnit = 'iso' | 's' | 'ms';
```

## Queries and data

Source: [`cache.ts`](../../packages/core/src/cache.ts), [`data.ts`](../../packages/core/src/data.ts), [`query.ts`](../../packages/core/src/query.ts), [`values.ts`](../../packages/core/src/values.ts)

### BUCKETS

Every way time may group; `none` when it doesn't.

```ts
const BUCKETS: readonly ['none', 'hour', 'day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter', 'year'];
```

### bucketStart

The start of the bucket containing an instant.

```ts
function bucketStart(ms: number, bucket: Bucket, zone?: string): number;
```

Uses: [`Bucket`](#bucket).

### checkQuery

Checks a query against the contract and returns it in canonical spelling: the source exists,
every field belongs to it, operators suit their fields, values parse, tokens sit where they
mean something, limits hold and aggregates are well formed.

```ts
function checkQuery(contract: AnyContract, raw: unknown, scope?: QueryScope): QueryCheck;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`QueryCheck`](#querycheck), [`QueryScope`](#queryscope).

### createData

Runs queries through the bindings, sharing results between everything that asks.

```ts
function createData(contract: AnyContract, fetchers: Fetchers, options?: DataOptions): DataClient;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`DataClient`](#dataclient), [`DataOptions`](#dataoptions), [`Fetchers`](#fetchers).

### DEFAULT_LIMIT

Rows a query returns when it doesn't say.

```ts
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 20;
```

### DIRECTIONS

Both sort directions.

```ts
const DIRECTIONS: readonly ['asc', 'desc'];
```

### formatValue

Formats a stored value for people, by its field's type.

```ts
function formatValue(field: Field, value: unknown, currency?: string, locale?: string): string;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-react`.

Uses: [`Field`](#field-type).

### fromRows

A fetcher over rows held in memory, applying every filter, sort and page it is asked for:
for demonstrations, tests and data an application already has.

```ts
function fromRows(rows: Readonly<Record<string, readonly object[]>>): Fetch;
```

Uses: [`Fetch`](#fetch).

### isToken

Whether a value is a token.

```ts
function isToken(value: string): value is Token;
```

Uses: [`Token`](#token).

### MAX_FIELDS

Fields a query may read.

```ts
const MAX_FIELDS = 12;
```

### MAX_FILTERS

Filters a query may apply.

```ts
const MAX_FILTERS = 8;
```

### MAX_SORTS

Sorts a query may apply.

```ts
const MAX_SORTS = 3;
```

### MEASURES

Every way a summary measures its rows; `none` for queries that return rows.

```ts
const MEASURES: readonly ['none', 'count', 'sum', 'avg', 'min', 'max', 'distinct'];
```

### NO_AGGREGATE

The aggregate of a query that returns rows: no measure, no grouping.

```ts
const NO_AGGREGATE: Aggregate;
```

Uses: [`Aggregate`](#aggregate).

### NONE

Stands in for "no field" wherever a schema can't leave a value out.

```ts
const NONE = 'none';
```

### parseTime

An instant in milliseconds, from an ISO date or time, or a token relative to the clock.

```ts
function parseTime(raw: string, clock: Clock): number | undefined;
```

Uses: [`Clock`](#clock).

### parseValue

Parses one filter value for a field. Relative times such as `-7d`, `today` and
`start:month` resolve against the clock, so a saved query stays relative.

```ts
function parseValue(field: Field, raw: string, clock: Clock): Parsed | undefined;
```

Uses: [`Clock`](#clock), [`Field`](#field-type), [`Parsed`](#parsed).

### partsIn

The wall-clock date and time of an instant in a zone.

```ts
function partsIn(ms: number, zone?: string): LocalParts;
```

Uses: [`LocalParts`](#localparts).

### PERIODS

Every calendar period relative times may name.

```ts
const PERIODS: readonly ['day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter', 'year'];
```

### query

Builds a query in code, filling in what's left out.

```ts
function query(
  source: string,
  parts?: {
    fields?: readonly string[];
    filter?: readonly Filter[];
    sort?: readonly Sort[];
    limit?: number;
    search?: string;
    aggregate?: Partial<Aggregate>;
  },
): Query;
```

Uses: [`Aggregate`](#aggregate), [`Filter`](#filter), [`Query`](#query-type), [`Sort`](#sort).

### runQuery

Runs a checked query: pushes down what the binding supports, does the rest here.

```ts
function runQuery(
  contract: AnyContract,
  fetchers: Fetchers,
  query: Query,
  options: RunOptions,
): Promise<QueryResult>;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Fetchers`](#fetchers), [`Query`](#query-type), [`QueryResult`](#queryresult), [`RunOptions`](#runoptions).

### SEARCH_LENGTH

Characters a query's search may hold.

```ts
const SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;
```

### startOf

The start of the day, ISO week, month, quarter or year containing an instant, in a zone.

```ts
function startOf(ms: number, period: Period, zone?: string): number;
```

Uses: [`Period`](#period).

### timeOf

A stored time as milliseconds since the epoch, whatever the field's unit.

```ts
function timeOf(field: Field, value: unknown): number | undefined;
```

Uses: [`Field`](#field-type).

### TOKENS

The page's entity, and the signed-in user, where the binding knows them.

```ts
const TOKENS: readonly ['$current', '$me'];
```

### VALUE_LENGTH

Longest text a filter value may hold.

```ts
const VALUE_LENGTH = 200;
```

### Aggregate

A summary instead of rows: one number, or one per group.

Uses: [`Bucket`](#bucket), [`Measure`](#measure).

| Property  | Type      | Description                                                                            |
| --------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `measure` | `Measure` | What to compute: a count, a sum, an average, a minimum, a maximum or a distinct count. |
| `of`      | `string`  | The field measured, or `none` to count rows.                                           |
| `by`      | `string`  | The field rows group by, or `none` for one number.                                     |
| `split`   | `string`  | A second grouping, for stacked charts, or `none`.                                      |
| `bucket`  | `Bucket`  | For time groupings: the size of each group.                                            |

### BindingContext

Who and where the user is, as far as the binding knows.

| Property    | Type     | Default | Description                                      |
| ----------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `me?`       | `string` |         | The signed-in user, for `$me`.                   |
| `timeZone?` | `string` | `'UTC'` | An IANA time zone, for "today" and time buckets. |
| `locale?`   | `string` |         | A BCP 47 locale, for formatting.                 |

### Bucket

How time groups: by hour, day, ISO week, month, quarter or year.

```ts
type Bucket = (typeof BUCKETS)[number];
```

Uses: [`BUCKETS`](#buckets).

### Clock

When a query runs, and where: "today" and "this month" depend on the user's time zone.

| Property    | Type     | Default | Description                   |
| ----------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------- |
| `now`       | `number` |         | Milliseconds since the epoch. |
| `timeZone?` | `string` | `'UTC'` | An IANA time zone.            |

### DataClient

Query results shared across an interface: fetched once, cached, refreshed when stale or after a
write to their source.

Uses: [`DataEntry`](#dataentry), [`DataScope`](#datascope), [`Query`](#query-type), [`QueryResult`](#queryresult).

| Property       | Type                                                          | Description                                                                      |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `read()`       | `(query: Query, scope?: DataScope) => DataEntry`              | The entry for a query, fetching when there is none, or when it is stale.         |
| `peek()`       | `(query: Query, scope?: DataScope) => DataEntry \| undefined` | The entry for a query as it stands, without fetching: safe inside a render.      |
| `load()`       | `(query: Query, scope?: DataScope) => Promise<QueryResult>`   | The result of a query, fresh or cached.                                          |
| `subscribe()`  | `(listener: () => void) => () => void`                        | Calls the listener whenever an entry changes; returns its removal.               |
| `invalidate()` | `(sources: readonly string[]) => void`                        | Marks results that read these sources stale, so they fetch again when next read. |

### DataEntry

A query's result as far as it is known. Stable between changes, so it is safe to render.

Uses: [`QueryResult`](#queryresult).

| Property  | Type                              | Description                                                                                 |
| --------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `status`  | `'loading' \| 'ready' \| 'error'` | Whether the result is loading, ready, or failed.                                            |
| `result?` | `QueryResult`                     | The result, once there is one; kept while a fresh one loads.                                |
| `error?`  | `string`                          | Why it failed, in words people read.                                                        |
| `stale`   | `boolean`                         | The result is older than its sources allow, or a write changed them; a fresh one is coming. |

### DataOptions

How a data client fetches and caches.

Uses: [`BindingContext`](#bindingcontext).

| Property       | Type                       | Default    | Description                                                                         |
| -------------- | -------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `now?`         | `() => number`             | `Date.now` | The clock, in milliseconds, for freshness and relative times.                       |
| `context?`     | `() => BindingContext`     |            | Who and where the user is: `me`, time zone and locale.                              |
| `concurrency?` | `number`                   | `4`        | Fetches running at once.                                                            |
| `capacity?`    | `number`                   | `200`      | Results kept.                                                                       |
| `onError?`     | `(error: unknown) => void` |            | Told when a fetch fails; the result says so too, and the last good one stays shown. |

### DataScope

What a page's queries need to know about the page: the row it is about.

| Property   | Type     | Description                                         |
| ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `current?` | `string` | The key of the row a page is about, for `$current`. |

### Direction

A sort direction: ascending or descending.

```ts
type Direction = (typeof DIRECTIONS)[number];
```

Uses: [`DIRECTIONS`](#directions).

### Fetch

The application's code that reads a source: a request in, rows out. It reads with the person's
own permissions, applying only the filters, sorts and paging its source declares.

```ts
type Fetch<R = unknown> = (
  request: FetchRequest,
  context: BindingContext,
) => Promise<FetchResult<R>>;
```

Uses: [`BindingContext`](#bindingcontext), [`FetchRequest`](#fetchrequest), [`FetchResult`](#fetchresult).

### Fetchers

One fetcher for every source, or one per source.

```ts
type Fetchers<C extends AnyContract = AnyContract> =
  | Fetch
  | {
      [S in SourceIdOf<C>]?: Fetch<RowOf<C, S>>;
    };
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Fetch`](#fetch), [`RowOf`](#rowof), [`SourceIdOf`](#sourceidof).

### FetchFilter

One filter a binding is asked to apply, on one of the source's own fields.

Uses: [`Op`](#op), [`Stored`](#stored).

| Property | Type                | Description                                          |
| -------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `field`  | `string`            | One of the source's own fields.                      |
| `op`     | `Op`                | The operator, one the source's capabilities declare. |
| `values` | `readonly Stored[]` | The values, parsed by the field's type.              |

### FetchRequest

What a binding is asked for. It applies only what its source's capabilities declare;
core does the rest.

Uses: [`Direction`](#direction), [`FetchFilter`](#fetchfilter).

| Property  | Type                                                 | Description                                              |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source`  | `string`                                             | The source to read.                                      |
| `fields`  | `readonly string[]`                                  | The fields core needs, for bindings that select columns. |
| `filter`  | `readonly FetchFilter[]`                             | Filters to apply, from those the source declares.        |
| `sort`    | `readonly { field: string; direction: Direction }[]` | Sorts to apply, from those the source declares.          |
| `limit`   | `number`                                             | Rows per page.                                           |
| `cursor?` | `string`                                             | The `next` of the previous page.                         |
| `search?` | `string`                                             | Text to look for, when the source searches itself.       |
| `signal?` | `unknown`                                            | An `AbortSignal` where the platform has one.             |

### FetchResult

What a `fetch` binding answers: the rows, where the next page starts, and the total when the API
knows it.

Type parameters: `R = unknown`.

| Property | Type           | Description                                                         |
| -------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rows`   | `readonly R[]` | The rows, as the API returns them.                                  |
| `next?`  | `string`       | Passed back as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page. |
| `total?` | `number`       | Every matching row, when the API counts them.                       |

### Filter

One filter of a query: a field, an operator, and its values as text, parsed by the field's type.

Uses: [`Op`](#op).

| Property | Type                | Description                                                           |
| -------- | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `field`  | `string`            | A qualified field name, such as `payments.status`.                    |
| `op`     | `Op`                | The operator, one the field's type allows.                            |
| `values` | `readonly string[]` | The values, as text: `between` takes two, `empty` and `present` none. |

### Group

One group of a summary. Money is in major units.

Uses: [`Stored`](#stored).

| Property     | Type             | Description                                                        |
| ------------ | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `by`         | `Stored \| null` | The group's value of the grouping field, or `null` for one number. |
| `label`      | `string`         | The group's value, as people read it.                              |
| `split`      | `Stored \| null` | The value of the second grouping, or `null` without one.           |
| `splitLabel` | `string`         | The second grouping's value, as people read it.                    |
| `value`      | `number \| null` | The measure, or `null` when nothing was measured.                  |
| `currency?`  | `string`         | For money: the currency the value is in, when one applies.         |

### LocalParts

A moment's calendar parts in a time zone.

| Property | Type     | Description                   |
| -------- | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `year`   | `number` | The year.                     |
| `month`  | `number` | The month, from 1.            |
| `day`    | `number` | The day of the month, from 1. |
| `hour`   | `number` | The hour, from 0 to 23.       |
| `minute` | `number` | The minute.                   |
| `second` | `number` | The second.                   |

### Measure
