| `import()`           | Takes a definition from `export`, checked against this contract like any change.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `explain()`          | Why a change was made, in plain words, with its evidence.                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `request()`          | Exactly what a planner would receive: all that leaves the device.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `summary()`          | Usage summarised per action and surface, as planners see it.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `flush()`            | Writes pending state to the store now.                                                                                                                                                                                           |

### UitiveOptions

What `createUitive` takes: the contract, and where state lives, who plans and the
application's code behind the contract.

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Autonomy`](#autonomy), [`Bindings`](#bindings), [`Environment`](#environment), [`Planner`](#planner), [`StabiliserOptions`](#stabiliseroptions), [`Store`](#store).

Type parameters: `C extends AnyContract`.

| Property       | Type                             | Default              | Description                                                                                                                                                    |
| -------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contract`     | `C`                              |                      | The contract `defineApp` returned.                                                                                                                             |
| `store?`       | `Store`                          | `memoryStore()`      | Where state persists.                                                                                                                                          |
| `planner?`     | `Planner`                        | `heuristicPlanner()` | Who plans: the deterministic planner, or `remotePlanner` for a model on the application's server. Simple commands are always answered locally.                 |
| `now?`         | `() => number`                   | `Date.now`           | The clock, in milliseconds; tests pass one that moves only when told.                                                                                          |
| `idleMinutes?` | `number`                         | `30`                 | Minutes without activity that end a session.                                                                                                                   |
| `autonomy?`    | `Autonomy`                       | `'mixed'`            | Used until the user chooses otherwise.                                                                                                                         |
| `learn?`       | `boolean`                        | `true`               | Whether the client plans from use by itself, once a session (see `learn`). With a model planner, each plan is one request to the application's server.         |
| `stabiliser?`  | `Partial<StabiliserOptions>`     |                      | How cautiously planned changes apply: how many per session, after how many sessions, and how long a reverted one waits.                                        |
| `bindings?`    | `Bindings<C>`                    |                      | The application's code behind the contract: reading sources, running actions, routing.                                                                         |
| `onError?`     | `(error: unknown) => void`       |                      | Called when storage or a planner fails; the interface keeps working.                                                                                           |
| `environment?` | `() => Environment \| undefined` |                      | For pages Uitive adapts from outside, such as in a browser extension: what the page offers now, sent with each request. Structure only, never the page's text. |

### View

`standard` shows the application as shipped; `yours` applies the user's definition.

```ts
type View = 'yours' | 'standard';
```

## Planners

Source: [`heuristic.ts`](../../packages/core/src/heuristic.ts), [`planner.ts`](../../packages/core/src/planner.ts)

### command

Keyword commands. Words are matched against items only for a stated goal; anything else
needs a model to understand, and guessing from shared words would only add noise.

```ts
function command(request: PlanRequest, contract: AnyContract): CommandResult;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`CommandResult`](#commandresult), [`PlanRequest`](#planrequest).

### heuristicPlanner

The deterministic planner: swaps rising overflow items with idle visible ones, under
capacity pressure and past a margin; understands keyword commands; and matches goals by
shared words: a deliberately naive stand-in that shows what a model adds.

```ts
function heuristicPlanner(): Planner;
```

Uses: [`Planner`](#planner).

### keywordCommand

Commands that name what to change ("hide share", "pin export", "compact"), answered
locally and instantly. Returns nothing for anything else.

```ts
function keywordCommand(request: PlanRequest, contract: AnyContract): CommandResult | undefined;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`CommandResult`](#commandresult), [`PlanRequest`](#planrequest).

### MARGIN

How much more an item must be used than the one it replaces: one recent use, plus a quarter
of the other's use, so two items used about equally never trade places on noise.

```ts
const MARGIN = 1;
```

### MIN_PROMOTE

A placement score worth about two recent uses: the least that earns a promotion.

```ts
const MIN_PROMOTE = 2;
```

### planResultSchema

Validates a plan result that arrived over the network.

```ts
const planResultSchema: ZodObject;
```

### remotePlanner

Asks a server-side planner, falling back locally on any failure, with the reason recorded.

```ts
function remotePlanner(options: RemotePlannerOptions): Planner;
```

Uses: [`Planner`](#planner), [`RemotePlannerOptions`](#remoteplanneroptions).

### ClaimedEvidence

Evidence as a planner claims it. Policy replaces it with values from the local summary.

```ts
type ClaimedEvidence =
  | {
      action: string;
      metric: Metric;
    }
  | {
      intent: true;
    };
```

Uses: [`Metric`](#metric).

### CommandResult

What the deterministic planner makes of a command: the operations, its status, and the candidates
when it was ambiguous.

```ts
type CommandResult = Pick<PlanResult, 'operations' | 'status' | 'candidates'>;
```

Uses: [`PlanResult`](#planresult).

### CommandStatus

What became of a request in the person's words: done, partly done, not allowed, ambiguous, not
something the application can change, or unanswered.

```ts
type CommandStatus =
  'done' | 'partial' | 'not_allowed' | 'ambiguous' | 'unsupported' | 'unavailable';
```

### Environment

The shape of a page the application doesn't describe itself, as a browser extension sees it:
which anchors and sources it found. Structure only; never the page's text.

| Property   | Type                                                             | Description                                                        |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `route`    | `string \| null`                                                 | The adapter route the page matched.                                |
| `anchors`  | `Readonly<Record<string, 'found' \| 'missing' \| 'ambiguous'>>`  | Whether each anchor was found once, not at all, or more than once. |
| `sources`  | `Readonly<Record<string, 'live' \| 'partial' \| 'unavailable'>>` | Whether each source could be read.                                 |
| `unmapped` | `{ links: number; buttons: number; tables: number }`             | What the adapter doesn't know about, counted and never named.      |

### FetchLike

The `fetch` `remotePlanner` calls: the platform's, or one that adds what a site needs, such as a
header.

```ts
type FetchLike = (
  url: string,
  init: {
    method: string;
    headers: Record<string, string>;
    body: string;
    signal?: unknown;
  },
) => Promise<PlannerResponse>;
```

Uses: [`PlannerResponse`](#plannerresponse).

### PlanMeta

How a plan was made: by which planner and model, how fast, at what cost, and whether it was
scoped or repaired.

| Property    | Type                                                                       | Description                                                       |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `planner`   | `string`                                                                   | The planner's name.                                               |
| `ms`        | `number`                                                                   | How long planning took, in milliseconds.                          |
| `subset?`   | `readonly string[]`                                                        | The sources the request was scoped to, for large contracts.       |
| `repaired?` | `boolean`                                                                  | A second round fixed what policy rejected in the first.           |
| `stages?`   | `number`                                                                   | Model calls made.                                                 |
| `model?`    | `string`                                                                   | The model that planned, for model planners.                       |
| `fellBack?` | `string`                                                                   | Why a fallback planner answered instead.                          |
| `usage?`    | `{ input: number; output: number; cacheRead: number; cacheWrite: number }` | Tokens the model read and wrote, and what the prompt cache saved. |
| `cost?`     | `number`                                                                   | Estimated cost in US dollars.                                     |

### Planner

Something that plans: the deterministic planner, a remote one, or a model planner on a server.

```ts
interface Planner {
  readonly name: string;
  plan(request: PlanRequest, contract: AnyContract, options?: PlanOptions): Promise<PlanResult>;
}
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`PlanOptions`](#planoptions), [`PlanRequest`](#planrequest), [`PlanResult`](#planresult).

| Property | Description                                                               |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`   | The planner's name, as plans report it.                                   |
| `plan()` | Proposes operations for a request. It sees schemas and usage, never rows. |

### PlannerResponse

What `remotePlanner` reads from a response: the platform's `Response` fits.

Uses: [`PlannerStream`](#plannerstream).

| Property   | Type                                    | Description                                       |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `ok`       | `boolean`                               | Whether the status is in the 200s.                |
| `status`   | `number`                                | The HTTP status.                                  |
| `json()`   | `() => Promise<unknown>`                | The body, parsed.                                 |
| `headers?` | `{ get(name: string): string \| null }` | The response's headers, for its content type.     |
| `body?`    | `PlannerStream \| null`                 | The body as a stream, when progress lines arrive. |

### PlannerStream

A response body read as a stream, for progress lines: the platform's `ReadableStream` fits.

| Property      | Type                                                               | Description                    |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------ |
| `getReader()` | `() => { read(): Promise<{ done: boolean; value?: Uint8Array }> }` | Reads the body chunk by chunk. |

### PlanOptions

What a planner may be given besides the request: a way to cancel, and a listener for progress.

Uses: [`PlanProgress`](#planprogress).

| Property      | Type                               | Description                                                           |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `signal?`     | `unknown`                          | An `AbortSignal` where the platform has one.                          |
| `onProgress?` | `(progress: PlanProgress) => void` | Called as the plan arrives; planners that can't stream never call it. |

### PlanProgress

How far a plan has come, for showing progress on long redesigns.

| Property   | Type                        | Description                                                       |
| ---------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stage`    | `'planning' \| 'repairing'` | Whether the model is planning, or repairing what policy rejected. |
| `elements` | `number`                    | Page elements written so far.                                     |

### PlanRequest

Everything a planner receives. This is all that leaves the device.

Uses: [`Environment`](#environment), [`StateView`](#stateview), [`UsageSummary`](#usagesummary).

| Property       | Type                               | Description                                                                     |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`         | `'plan' \| 'command'`              | A plan from use, or a command in the person's words.                            |
| `contract`     | `{ id: string; hash: string }`     | The contract's ID and hash; the server holds the contract itself.               |
| `session`      | `number`                           | The current session.                                                            |
| `summary`      | `UsageSummary`                     | Usage, as numbers.                                                              |
| `state`        | `StateView`                        | The interface as it is, as IDs.                                                 |
| `contexts`     | `Readonly<Record<string, string>>` | Context values active now, by context name.                                     |
| `route?`       | `string`                           | The route in view; never the row it shows.                                      |
| `text?`        | `string`                           | The command, in the user's words.                                               |
| `goal?`        | `string`                           | The goal the user stated, in their words.                                       |
| `environment?` | `Environment`                      | For pages Uitive adapts from outside, such as in the extension: what was found. |

### PlanResult

What a planner answers: proposed operations, a status for commands, and how the plan was made.

Uses: [`CommandStatus`](#commandstatus), [`PlanMeta`](#planmeta), [`ProposedOperation`](#proposedoperation).

| Property      | Type                           | Description                                        |
| ------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `origin`      | `'heuristic' \| 'model'`       | Which planner produced the operations.             |
| `operations`  | `readonly ProposedOperation[]` | The proposed operations, for policy to check.      |
| `status?`     | `CommandStatus`                | For commands: what became of the request.          |
| `candidates?` | `readonly string[]`            | For ambiguous commands: what the words could mean. |
| `meta`        | `PlanMeta`                     | How the plan was made.                             |

### ProposedOperation

A change a planner proposes, with the evidence it claims; policy checks both before anything
applies.

Uses: [`Change`](#change), [`ClaimedEvidence`](#claimedevidence).

| Property   | Type                         | Description                                                                                |
| ---------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `change`   | `Change`                     | What it would change.                                                                      |
| `evidence` | `readonly ClaimedEvidence[]` | What it claims to rest on; policy replaces the figures with the true ones.                 |
| `note?`    | `string`                     | A short plain-text note, shown beneath the deterministic reason.                           |
| `scope?`   | `'explicit' \| 'goal'`       | For commands: `explicit` when the user named the target, `goal` when it serves their goal. |

### RemotePlannerOptions

Where `remotePlanner` sends requests, and what answers when the server can't.

Uses: [`FetchLike`](#fetchlike), [`Planner`](#planner).

| Property     | Type                     | Default                             | Description                                                                  |
| ------------ | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `url`        | `string`                 |                                     | The handler's base URL; requests go to `<url>/plan` and `<url>/command`.     |
| `fallback?`  | `Planner`                |                                     | Answers when the server can't.                                               |
| `fetch?`     | `FetchLike`              | `globalThis.fetch`                  | The `fetch` it calls.                                                        |
| `timeoutMs?` | `number`                 | 60000 for plans, 20000 for commands | How long to wait before the fallback answers.                                |
| `headers?`   | `Record<string, string>` |                                     | Headers sent with every request, such as one the server's `authorize` reads. |

### StateView

The current interface, as a planner sees it: IDs only.

```ts
interface StateView {
  lists: readonly {
    surface: string;
    context?: string;
    visible: readonly string[];
    pinned: readonly string[];
  }[];
  choices: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  collections: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
  pages: readonly {
    surface: string;
    context?: string;
    value: AnyPage;
  }[];
  userPages: readonly {
    slug: string;
    title: string;
  }[];
  userPage?: {
    slug: string;
    value: AnyPage;
  };
  user: readonly string[];
  cooldowns: readonly string[];
  blocked: readonly string[];
  frozen: boolean;
  recent: readonly {
    key: string;
    outcome: 'kept' | 'reverted';
  }[];
}
```

Uses: [`AnyPage`](#anypage).

| Property      | Description                                                             |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lists`       | Each list's visible and pinned items, per context value in view.        |
| `choices`     | Each choice's value.                                                    |
| `collections` | Each collection's item IDs.                                             |
| `pages`       | The pages in view now, as they are.                                     |
| `userPages`   | The pages the user made.                                                |
| `userPage?`   | The user's own page in view, if any.                                    |
| `user`        | Operation keys the user decided themselves; planners leave these alone. |
| `cooldowns`   | Operation keys cooling down after a revert.                             |
| `blocked`     | Operation keys reverted twice, never proposed again.                    |
| `frozen`      | Whether the person froze planned changes.                               |
| `recent`      | How the user answered recent changes.                                   |

## Definitions and policy

Source: [`definition.ts`](../../packages/core/src/definition.ts), [`explain.ts`](../../packages/core/src/explain.ts), [`limits.ts`](../../packages/core/src/limits.ts), [`policy.ts`](../../packages/core/src/policy.ts), [`stabiliser.ts`](../../packages/core/src/stabiliser.ts)

### canonical

Resolves every ID in a change to the contract's canonical spelling.

```ts
function canonical(change: Change, contract: AnyContract): Change;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Change`](#change).

### check

Checks operations in order, each against the definition as if the earlier ones applied.

```ts
function check(operations: readonly Operation[], context: PolicyContext): CheckResult;
```

Uses: [`CheckResult`](#checkresult), [`Operation`](#operation), [`PolicyContext`](#policycontext).

### checkPageValue

Validates a whole page against its blocks, regions, limits and the application's rules.

```ts
function checkPageValue(
  contract: AnyContract,
  spec: AnyPageSpec,
  value: unknown,
  context?: string,
  planned?: boolean,
): AnyPage;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`AnyPage`](#anypage), [`AnyPageSpec`](#anypagespec).

### DEFAULT_STABILISER

The stabiliser's defaults: two changes per safe moment, three sessions of dwell, five of cooldown
and expiry.

```ts
const DEFAULT_STABILISER: StabiliserOptions;
```

Uses: [`StabiliserOptions`](#stabiliseroptions).

### describe

Explains an operation in plain words: what changed and where, who proposed it, and on what
evidence.

```ts
function describe(operation: Operation, contract: AnyContract): Explanation;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Explanation`](#explanation), [`Operation`](#operation).

### emptyDefinition

A definition with no changes yet: the application as shipped.

```ts
function emptyDefinition(contract: AnyContract): Definition;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Definition`](#definition).

### EVERY

Pages keyed by context can be redesigned for one value, or for every value at once.

```ts
const EVERY = '*';
```

### isApplied

Whether an operation counts towards the interface: active, or kept by the person.

```ts
function isApplied(operation: AppliedOperation): boolean;
```

Uses: [`AppliedOperation`](#appliedoperation).

### MAX_USER_PAGES

Most pages one person can make.

```ts
const MAX_USER_PAGES = 20;
```

### METRICS

Every usage statistic an operation may cite as evidence.

```ts
const METRICS: readonly Metric[];
```

Uses: [`Metric`](#metric).

### migrateDefinition

Brings a stored definition up to date: version 1 kept pages as sections of blocks, which
convert mechanically to flat elements.

```ts
function migrateDefinition(
  definition: Omit<Definition, 'schemaVersion'> & {
    schemaVersion: number;
  },
): Definition;
```

Uses: [`Definition`](#definition).

### MIN_IDLE

Sessions an item must sit unused before usage alone justifies moving it to overflow.

```ts
const MIN_IDLE = 3;
```

### NOTE_LENGTH

Longest model note shown; notes with digits are dropped, since numbers come from the summary.

```ts
const NOTE_LENGTH = 140;
```

### operationKey

Identifies what an operation does, regardless of when or by whom: for cooldowns and repeats.

```ts
function operationKey(change: Change): string;
```

Uses: [`Change`](#change).

### redesigned

Whether a page has a redesign of its own, for this context value or for every value.

```ts
function redesigned(definition: Definition, surface: string, context: string | undefined): boolean;
```

Uses: [`Definition`](#definition).

### resolveChoice

A choice's value after a definition: the last applied choice, or its default.

```ts
function resolveChoice(
  contract: AnyContract,
  definition: Definition | undefined,
  surface: string,
): string;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Definition`](#definition).

### resolveCollection

A collection after a definition: accepted items and waiting suggestions.

```ts
function resolveCollection(
  contract: AnyContract,
  definition: Definition | undefined,
  surface: string,
): CollectionValue;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`CollectionValue`](#collectionvalue), [`Definition`](#definition).

### resolveList

Folds a definition over a list. `since` marks items moved by operations applied in or after
that session, for "moved" markers.

```ts
function resolveList(
  contract: AnyContract,
  definition: Definition | undefined,
  surface: string,
  context?: string,
  since?: number,
): ListState;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Definition`](#definition), [`ListState`](#liststate).

### resolvePage

The page a definition yields: a redesign for this context value, else one for every value,
else the standard page. A suggested redesign can be previewed without applying it.

```ts
function resolvePage(
  contract: AnyContract,
  definition: Definition | undefined,
  surface: string,
  context?: string,
  preview?: string,
): AnyPage;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`AnyPage`](#anypage), [`Definition`](#definition).

### resolveUserPages

The user's own pages, in the order they made them.

```ts
function resolveUserPages(definition: Definition | undefined): UserPage[];
```

Uses: [`Definition`](#definition), [`UserPage`](#userpage).

### SLUG_PATTERN

User page slugs: short, lowercase, URL-safe.

```ts
const SLUG_PATTERN: RegExp = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$/;
```

### TEXT_LENGTH

Longest string anywhere in a block's props or a collection item.

```ts
const TEXT_LENGTH = 500;
```

### TITLE_LENGTH

Longest title a section, tab, label or collection item may have.

```ts
const TITLE_LENGTH = 80;
```

### USER_PAGES

User pages share this reserved surface name: they belong to no surface the application declares.

```ts
const USER_PAGES = 'userPages';
```

### validateOutput

The half of policy that needs no user state: contract names, what planners may do, page and
query rules, and item schemas. The server runs it to give the model one chance to repair its
plan; the client still runs all of policy.

```ts
function validateOutput(
  contract: AnyContract,
  operations: readonly ProposedOperation[],
): {
  accepted: ProposedOperation[];
  rejected: OutputRejection[];
};
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`OutputRejection`](#outputrejection), [`ProposedOperation`](#proposedoperation).

### AppliedOperation

An operation in a person's definition, with its status: active, kept, reverted, suggested or
dismissed.

Uses: [`Status`](#status).

| Property     | Type                                                    | Description                                                                     |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `status`     | `Status`                                                | Whether it is active, kept, reverted, suggested or dismissed.                   |
| `session`    | `number`                                                | The session it was applied in.                                                  |
| `adaptation` | `string`                                                | The adaptation that applied it.                                                 |
| `id`         | `string`                                                | Its ID, for revert, keep and explanations.                                      |
| `change`     | `Change`                                                | What it changes.                                                                |
| `origin`     | `Origin`                                                | Who proposed it: learning, the model, or the person.                            |
| `layer`      | `'model' \| 'user'`                                     | User-layer operations outrank model-layer ones.                                 |
| `evidence`   | `readonly Evidence[]`                                   | What it rests on: usage figures, or the person's words.                         |
| `note?`      | `string`                                                | A short plain-text note from the model, shown beneath the deterministic reason. |
| `basedOn`    | `{ version: number; summary: string; session: number }` | What the operation was planned against, for rebasing and expiry.                |

### Change

One change to one surface, by its kind.

```ts
type Change = ListChange | ChoiceChange | CollectionChange | PageChange | UserPageChange;
```

Uses: [`ChoiceChange`](#choicechange), [`CollectionChange`](#collectionchange), [`ListChange`](#listchange), [`PageChange`](#pagechange), [`UserPageChange`](#userpagechange).

### CheckResult

What policy accepted, canonical, and what it refused, with reasons.

Uses: [`Operation`](#operation), [`Rejection`](#rejection).

| Property   | Type          | Description                                    |
| ---------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `accepted` | `Operation[]` | The operations that passed, in canonical form. |
| `rejected` | `Rejection[]` | The operations refused, with reasons.          |

### ChoiceChange

A choice set to one of its values.

| Property  | Type       | Description                     |
| --------- | ---------- | ------------------------------- |
| `kind`    | `'choice'` | Says the change is to a choice. |
| `surface` | `string`   | The choice.                     |
| `op`      | `'set'`    | Choices are only ever set.      |
| `value`   | `string`   | The value chosen.               |

### CollectionChange

An item added to, changed in or removed from a collection.

| Property  | Type                            | Description                                    |
| --------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`    | `'collection'`                  | Says the change is to a collection.            |
| `surface` | `string`                        | The collection.                                |
| `op`      | `'add' \| 'update' \| 'remove'` | Whether the item is added, changed or removed. |
| `item`    | `string`                        | The item's ID.                                 |
| `value?`  | `unknown`                       | For `add` and `update`: the item itself.       |

### Definition

One user's interface: the standard layout plus every operation applied to it.

Uses: [`AppliedOperation`](#appliedoperation).

| Property        | Type                                        | Description                                                                     |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemaVersion` | `2`                                         | 2 since pages became flat elements; version 1 definitions are migrated on load. |
| `contract`      | `string`                                    | The hash of the contract it was made against.                                   |
| `version`       | `number`                                    | Increments on every change.                                                     |
| `operations`    | `readonly AppliedOperation[]`               | Every operation applied, in order.                                              |
| `cooldowns`     | `readonly { key: string; until: number }[]` | Operation keys a planner may not propose until a session.                       |
| `blocked`       | `readonly string[]`                         | Operation keys reverted twice: never proposed again.                            |
| `frozen`        | `boolean`                                   | When frozen, planners change nothing.                                           |
| `goal?`         | `string`                                    | The goal the user stated in their own words.                                    |

### Evidence

Why an operation is justified: a usage statistic taken from the summary, or the user's words.

```ts
type Evidence =
  | {
      action: string;
      metric: Metric;
      value: number;
      window?: number;
    }
  | {
      intent: string;
    };
```

Uses: [`Metric`](#metric).

### Explanation

What a person reads about an operation: what changed and why, with true numbers only.

| Property | Type     | Description                                     |
| -------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `title`  | `string` | What changed, such as "Table added to Toolbar". |
| `reason` | `string` | Why, with the evidence's true numbers.          |
| `note?`  | `string` | A short note from the model, if it wrote one.   |

### ListChange

A change to a list: an action promoted or demoted by learning, or moved, pinned, unpinned, hidden
or restored by the person.

| Property   | Type                                                                         | Description                                                                                                  |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `kind`     | `'list'`                                                                     | Says the change is to a list.                                                                                |
| `surface`  | `string`                                                                     | The list.                                                                                                    |
| `context?` | `string`                                                                     | The context value it applies to, for lists keyed by context.                                                 |
| `op`       | `'promote' \| 'demote' \| 'move' \| 'pin' \| 'unpin' \| 'hide' \| 'restore'` | What happens to the item: learning promotes and demotes; the person moves, pins, unpins, hides and restores. |
| `target`   | `string`                                                                     | The action.                                                                                                  |
| `index?`   | `number`                                                                     | For `move`: the position among visible items.                                                                |
| `evict?`   | `string`                                                                     | For operations that add a visible item: the item that made room, fixed when applied.                         |

### ListState

A list after folding a definition over it: its value, and what is visible, pinned, hidden and
standard.

Uses: [`ListValue`](#listvalue).

| Property   | Type          | Description                                         |
| ---------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`    | `ListValue`   | The list as the person has it.                      |
| `visible`  | `Set<string>` | The items that show.                                |
| `pinned`   | `Set<string>` | The items the person pinned.                        |
| `hidden`   | `Set<string>` | Items the user hid, until they restore or pin them. |
| `standard` | `Set<string>` | The items that show in the standard layout.         |

### Metric

Usage statistics an operation may cite.

```ts
type Metric = 'uses' | 'activeSessions' | 'viaOverflow' | 'viaPalette' | 'idleSessions';
```

### Operation

A change with its provenance: who proposed it, on what evidence, against which version, and on
which layer.

Uses: [`Change`](#change), [`Evidence`](#evidence), [`Origin`](#origin).

| Property   | Type                                                    | Description                                                                     |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string`                                                | Its ID, for revert, keep and explanations.                                      |
| `change`   | `Change`                                                | What it changes.                                                                |
| `origin`   | `Origin`                                                | Who proposed it: learning, the model, or the person.                            |
| `layer`    | `'model' \| 'user'`                                     | User-layer operations outrank model-layer ones.                                 |
| `evidence` | `readonly Evidence[]`                                   | What it rests on: usage figures, or the person's words.                         |
| `note?`    | `string`                                                | A short plain-text note from the model, shown beneath the deterministic reason. |
| `basedOn`  | `{ version: number; summary: string; session: number }` | What the operation was planned against, for rebasing and expiry.                |

### Origin

Who proposed an operation: the deterministic planner, a model, or the person.

```ts
type Origin = 'heuristic' | 'model' | 'user';
```

### OutputRejection

A proposed operation the static half of policy turned down, and why.

Uses: [`ProposedOperation`](#proposedoperation), [`Rule`](#rule).

| Property    | Type                | Description                     |
| ----------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `operation` | `ProposedOperation` | The proposed operation refused. |
| `rule`      | `Rule`              | The rule it broke.              |
| `message`   | `string`            | Why, for the model to repair.   |

### PageChange

A page redesigned outright, or put back to standard.

Uses: [`AnyPage`](#anypage).

| Property   | Type               | Description                                   |
| ---------- | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`     | `'page'`           | Says the change is to a page.                 |
| `surface`  | `string`           | The page.                                     |
| `context?` | `string`           | A context value, or `*` for every value.      |
| `op`       | `'set' \| 'reset'` | Redesigned outright, or put back to standard. |
| `value?`   | `AnyPage`          | For `set`: the whole new page.                |

### Pending

A checked operation waiting for a safe moment.

| Property   | Type                                                    | Description                                                                         |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `key`      | `string`                                                | What it does, regardless of when or by whom, for cooldowns and repeats.             |
| `strength` | `number`                                                | How strong its evidence is; past the margin, a model's change needs no second plan. |
| `held`     | `boolean`                                               | Held until a second plan proposes it again, unless its strength clears the margin.  |
| `id`       | `string`                                                | Its ID, for revert, keep and explanations.                                          |
| `change`   | `Change`                                                | What it changes.                                                                    |
| `origin`   | `Origin`                                                | Who proposed it: learning, the model, or the person.                                |
| `layer`    | `'model' \| 'user'`                                     | User-layer operations outrank model-layer ones.                                     |
| `evidence` | `readonly Evidence[]`                                   | What it rests on: usage figures, or the person's words.                             |
| `note?`    | `string`                                                | A short plain-text note from the model, shown beneath the deterministic reason.     |
| `basedOn`  | `{ version: number; summary: string; session: number }` | What the operation was planned against, for rebasing and expiry.                    |

### PolicyContext

What policy checks operations against: the contract, the person's definition, usage, the session
and any stated intent.

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Definition`](#definition), [`UsageSummary`](#usagesummary).

| Property     | Type           | Description                                                               |
| ------------ | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contract`   | `AnyContract`  | The contract.                                                             |
| `definition` | `Definition`   | The person's definition.                                                  |
| `summary`    | `UsageSummary` | Usage, as numbers.                                                        |
| `session`    | `number`       | The current session.                                                      |
| `intent?`    | `string`       | The user's own words behind this request: a command or their stated goal. |

### Rejection

An operation policy refused, the rule it broke, and why, in words people read.

Uses: [`Operation`](#operation), [`Rule`](#rule).

| Property    | Type        | Description                |
| ----------- | ----------- | -------------------------- |
| `operation` | `Operation` | The operation refused.     |
| `rule`      | `Rule`      | The rule it broke.         |
| `message`   | `string`    | Why, in words people read. |

### Rule

The rule an operation broke, named in its rejection: such as `required` for hiding a required
item, or `capacity` for a full list.

```ts
type Rule =
  | 'unknown'
  | 'kind'
  | 'required'
  | 'precedence'
  | 'frozen'
  | 'cooldown'
  | 'blocked'
  | 'evidence'
  | 'validator'
  | 'noop'
  | 'capacity';
```

### StabiliserOptions

How cautiously planned changes apply, so the interface never moves while someone works and
settles rather than churns.

| Property   | Type     | Default | Description                                                                 |
| ---------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `budget`   | `number` | `2`     | Structural changes applied at one safe moment.                              |
| `dwell`    | `number` | `3`     | Sessions an item keeps its place after it moves.                            |
| `cooldown` | `number` | `5`     | Sessions a reverted change waits before it may return.                      |
| `expiry`   | `number` | `5`     | Sessions a pending change stays valid.                                      |
| `margin`   | `number` | `1`     | Strength at which a model change applies without waiting for a second plan. |

### Status

`suggested` operations add collection items for the user to accept; `kept` ones were
confirmed by the user and join the user layer.

```ts
type Status = 'active' | 'kept' | 'reverted' | 'suggested' | 'dismissed';
```

### UserPage

A page the user made.

Uses: [`AnyPage`](#anypage).

| Property    | Type      | Description                                   |
| ----------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `slug`      | `string`  | Its slug: the page lives at `/uitive/<slug>`. |
| `title`     | `string`  | Its title, as the person named it.            |
| `value`     | `AnyPage` | The page.                                     |
| `operation` | `string`  | The operation that created it.                |

### UserPageChange

A page the user made themselves, served at `/uitive/<slug>`.

Uses: [`USER_PAGES`](#user_pages), [`AnyPage`](#anypage).

| Property  | Type                                        | Description                                               |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`    | `'userPage'`                                | Says the change is to one of the person's own pages.      |
| `surface` | `typeof USER_PAGES`                         | Always `userPages`.                                       |
| `op`      | `'create' \| 'rename' \| 'set' \| 'delete'` | Whether the page is made, renamed, redesigned or deleted. |
| `slug`    | `string`                                    | The page's slug, in its address.                          |
| `title?`  | `string`                                    | For `create` and `rename`.                                |
| `value?`  | `AnyPage`                                   | For `create` and `set`: the whole page.                   |

## Usage and simulation

Source: [`simulate.ts`](../../packages/core/src/simulate.ts), [`usage.ts`](../../packages/core/src/usage.ts)

### DECAY

Each session back weighs this much less.

```ts
const DECAY = 0.85;
```

### random

A seeded pseudo-random generator (mulberry32), so a simulation repeats exactly.

```ts
function random(seed: number): () => number;
```

### rank

Every action ranked for a palette: decayed ranking score, then contract order.

```ts
function rank(contract: AnyContract, events: readonly UsageEvent[], session: number): string[];
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`UsageEvent`](#usageevent).

### simulate

Drives a client through sessions as a persona would: each session starts (applying pending
changes at the safe moment), the persona works, and a plan is made at the end.

```ts
function simulate<C extends AnyContract>(
  client: Uitive<C>,
  persona: Persona,
  options: {
    sessions: number;
    seed: number;
    plan?: boolean;
  },
): Promise<SessionReport[]>;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Persona`](#persona), [`SessionReport`](#sessionreport), [`Uitive`](#uitive).

### summarise

Summarises usage per action and surface over recent sessions, with older sessions weighing less.

```ts
function summarise(
  contract: AnyContract,
  definition: Definition,
  events: readonly UsageEvent[],
  sessions: readonly SessionRecord[],
  session: number,
): UsageSummary;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Definition`](#definition), [`SessionRecord`](#sessionrecord), [`UsageEvent`](#usageevent), [`UsageSummary`](#usagesummary).

### VIAS

Every way an action may be reached.

```ts
const VIAS: readonly Via[];
```

Uses: [`Via`](#via).

### visibleLists

The visible items of every list, for reports and assertions.

```ts
function visibleLists<C extends AnyContract>(client: Uitive<C>): Record<string, readonly string[]>;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Uitive`](#uitive).

### WINDOW

Sessions the summary looks back over, including the current one.

```ts
const WINDOW = 10;
```

### Persona

A simulated user: how often they use each action, and how they reach it.

| Property      | Type                                                                          | Default    | Description                                                                     |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`        | `string`                                                                      |            | Its name, as reports show it.                                                   |
| `description` | `string`                                                                      |            | Who it stands for.                                                              |
| `weights`     | `Readonly<Record<string, number>>`                                            |            | Relative frequencies of the actions this persona uses.                          |
| `actions?`    | `readonly [number, number]`                                                   | `[12, 24]` | Actions per session, inclusive.                                                 |
| `contexts?`   | `(action: string, draw: () => number) => Record<string, string> \| undefined` |            | Context values active for an action, such as the service a verb happens on.     |
| `shift?`      | `{ session: number; weights: Readonly<Record<string, number>> }`              |            | From this session on, these weights apply instead: a change of behaviour.       |
| `palette?`    | `number`                                                                      | `0.3`      | How often an overflow item is reached through the palette rather than overflow. |

### SessionRecord

One session: when it started, and the context values it saw.

| Property    | Type                       | Description                                                |
| ----------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `index`     | `number`                   | The session's number, counted from the first.              |
| `startedAt` | `number`                   | When it started, in milliseconds.                          |
| `contexts`  | `Record<string, string[]>` | Context values active during the session, by context name. |

### SessionReport

One simulated session: what each list showed at its start, and what changed then and after.

Uses: [`Adaptation`](#adaptation).

| Property   | Type                                | Description                                                                               |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session`  | `number`                            | The session's number.                                                                     |
| `visible`  | `Record<string, readonly string[]>` | Visible items of each list at the session's start, keyed `surface` or `surface\|context`. |
| `applied?` | `Adaptation`                        | The adaptation applied at the session's start, if any.                                    |
| `planned?` | `Adaptation`                        | The plan made at the session's end, if any.                                               |

### UsageEvent

One activation. Never text typed into the application, never page content.

Uses: [`Via`](#via).

| Property    | Type                     | Description                                                          |
| ----------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `action`    | `string`                 | The action used.                                                     |
| `via`       | `Via`                    | How it was reached.                                                  |
| `session`   | `number`                 | The session it happened in.                                          |
| `surface?`  | `string`                 | The surface it was reached on, when known.                           |
| `element?`  | `string`                 | The page element it came from, for actions run from generated pages. |
| `contexts?` | `Record<string, string>` | Context values active when it happened, by context name.             |
| `typed?`    | `boolean`                | For palette picks: whether the user typed a search first.            |

### UsageRow

One action's usage on one surface, as planners see it: uses, sessions, and how it was reached.

| Property         | Type                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `surface`        | `string`                  | The surface.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `context?`       | `string`                  | The context value, for surfaces keyed by context.                                                                                                                             |
| `action`         | `string`                  | The action.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `place`          | `'visible' \| 'overflow'` | Where it is now.                                                                                                                                                              |
| `pinned`         | `boolean`                 | Whether the person pinned it.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `uses`           | `number`                  | Uses within the window.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `activeSessions` | `number`                  | Sessions within the window with at least one use.                                                                                                                             |
| `viaOverflow`    | `number`                  | Uses reached from overflow, within the window.                                                                                                                                |
| `viaPalette`     | `number`                  | Uses reached by searching, within the window.                                                                                                                                 |
| `viaSuggested`   | `number`                  | Uses reached through a suggestion, within the window.                                                                                                                         |
| `idleSessions`   | `number`                  | Consecutive recent sessions it was visible and unused, while its surface was in use.                                                                                          |
| `placement`      | `number`                  | Decayed placement score, with overflow use weighing most: decides who deserves a place.                                                                                       |
| `activity`       | `number`                  | Decayed use with every path weighing the same: compares items for a swap. Comparing placement instead would oscillate: an item used from overflow always outscores its equal. |
| `ranking`        | `number`                  | Decayed ranking score, rounded to hundredths.                                                                                                                                 |

### UsageSummary

The deterministic statistics a planner sees: the only usage that leaves the device.

Uses: [`UsageRow`](#usagerow).

| Property  | Type                  | Description                                           |
| --------- | --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `session` | `number`              | The current session.                                  |
| `window`  | `number`              | Sessions the window covers.                           |
| `rows`    | `readonly UsageRow[]` | One row per action and surface.                       |
| `hash`    | `string`              | Changes when the leading items of any surface change. |

### Via

The path a user took to an action.

```ts
type Via = 'region' | 'overflow' | 'suggested' | 'palette' | 'shortcut' | 'command';
```

## Advanced

Used by Uitive's own packages and by tools built on them. These may change between minor versions.

Source: [`hash.ts`](../../packages/core/src/hash.ts), [`retrieval.ts`](../../packages/core/src/retrieval.ts)

### actionsInScope

The actions a scoped request may name: every list's items, and the subset's actions.

```ts
function actionsInScope(contract: AnyContract, subset: Subset): string[];
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Subset`](#subset).

### areasOf

The areas of a contract, one per source.

```ts
function areasOf(contract: AnyContract): Area[];
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Area`](#area).

### EXTRA_AREAS

Areas added by relevance, beyond those on screen.

```ts
const EXTRA_AREAS = 2;
```

### hash

A short, deterministic, non-cryptographic hash (cyrb53) of a value's stable serialisation.

```ts
function hash(value: unknown): string;
```

### MAX_ACTIONS

Actions in a subset at most, besides those lists hold.

```ts
const MAX_ACTIONS = 24;
```

### MAX_SOURCES

Sources in a subset at most.

```ts
const MAX_SOURCES = 8;
```

### rankAreas

Areas ranked by BM25 against some words, best first; areas with no match are left out.

```ts
function rankAreas(
  areas: readonly Area[],
  text: string,
): {
  source: string;
  score: number;
}[];
```

Uses: [`Area`](#area).

### selectSubset

The part of a contract a request may use: everything, when it is small; otherwise the areas
on screen plus the most relevant few. Few distinct subsets keep compiled grammars and prompt
caches warm.

```ts
function selectSubset(contract: AnyContract, options?: SubsetOptions): Subset;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`Subset`](#subset), [`SubsetOptions`](#subsetoptions).

### sourcesInView

The sources a request's screen shows: its pages' queries and the row its route is about.

```ts
function sourcesInView(contract: AnyContract, request: PlanRequest): string[];
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](#anycontract), [`PlanRequest`](#planrequest).

### stableStringify

JSON with object keys sorted, so equal values always serialise to the same bytes.

```ts
function stableStringify(value: unknown): string;
```

### terms

Lowercase words, split at punctuation, snake_case and camelCase, stemmed lightly.

```ts
function terms(text: string): string[];
```

### Area

One source with everything that belongs to it: what a planner is shown together.

| Property  | Type                | Description                                 |
| --------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `source`  | `string`            | The source at its centre.                   |
| `actions` | `readonly string[]` | Actions that act on its rows, or change it. |
| `routes`  | `readonly string[]` | Routes that show its rows.                  |
| `terms`   | `readonly string[]` | The words it is found by.                   |

### Subset

What a request may use: its sources, and the actions and routes that come with them.

| Property  | Type                | Description                                                           |
| --------- | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sources` | `readonly string[]` | The sources a request plans over.                                     |
| `actions` | `readonly string[]` | Its areas' actions, and others its words name: at most `MAX_ACTIONS`. |
| `routes`  | `readonly string[]` | The routes that show them.                                            |

### SubsetOptions

How to scope a large contract for one request: what was said, what is on screen, and how much to
keep.

| Property      | Type                | Default | Description                                      |
| ------------- | ------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `text?`       | `string`            |         | What the person said, and their goal.            |
| `inView?`     | `readonly string[]` |         | Sources on screen now, always included.          |
| `maxSources?` | `number`            | `8`     | Sources the subset may hold.                     |
| `extra?`      | `number`            | `2`     | Areas added by relevance beyond those on screen. |
